title: Daybreak for Frontline Defenders: $1B to protect essential services
summary: OpenAI 推出 Daybreak for Frontline Defenders 计划，承诺投入 10 亿美元，扩大前沿网络 AI、培训和支持对关键服务的可及性。
highlights: OpenAI introduces Daybreak for Frontline Defenders.
A $1 billion commitment expands access to frontier cyber AI, training, and support for essential services.
